fields.name: CacheFolder
fields.label: Cache Folder
fields.description: Folder path for SQLite Data cache. Ensure this folder exists and is writable.

fields.name: EmbeddingServiceSettings.Type
fields.label: Embedding Service Type
fields.description: Select the embedding service type. 'local' uses a local model, 'jina' uses Jina AI API, and 'openai' uses OpenAI API.

fields.name: EmbeddingServiceSettings.ApiKey
fields.label: Embedding Service API Key
fields.description: Enter the API key for the selected embedding service.

fields.name: EmbeddingServiceSettings.Model
fields.label: Embedding Service Model
fields.description: Enter the model for the selected embedding service.

fields.name: EmbeddingServiceSettings.Url
fields.label: Embedding Service URL
fields.description: Enter the URL for the selected embedding service.

fields.name: VectorProviderSettings.VectorDBFolder
fields.label: SQLite Folder for Vector DB
fields.description: Folder path for SQLite vector DB files. Ensure this folder exists and is writable.

fields.name: VectorProviderSettings.Url
fields.label: URL
fields.description: needed in case of Chroma, Qdrant, Azure or any other providers where a http client needs to be used

fields.name: VectorProviderSettings.ApiKey
fields.label: Api Key
fields.description: ignore where it is not necessary, like Sqlite

fields.name: VectorProviderSettings.ConnectionString
fields.label: Connection String
fields.description: needed for SQL Server or PostGres vector DB
